reviewer: Fresh independent GPT-6.1 Sol combat reviewer
build: Build04, source stable during browser review

ratings.reason: Meaningful improvement: recovery is a legible commitment with partial rewards, extraction is a defended hold, directional damage feedback exists, and roles/objectives are more readable. The prototype still has one arena/one weapon, weak pressure against continuous movement, limited anticipatory feedback for offscreen charges, a short finale, and little reason to replay beyond score/difficulty. It is not a10/10 game or AAA-ready.

methods: 35 seconds normal square movement with active enemies, no firing/dash; then up to5.6seconds stationary aim/fire using instrumented visible target positions.

Separate targeted test: RAF stopped, enemies cleared to isolate channel, arranged positions/resources, fixed-step debug advance; partial recovery/cancel/complete and extraction progress/leave/return. Not a normal mission.

recovery.memoryText: “Every signal is a person. If you can hear me, we are still here.”

extraction.note: At last controlled step progress was0.9999999999999972 and displayed100% while phase remainedplaying. This is at most one extra frame from threshold/rounding, not a demonstrated stuck extraction.

improvementsVerified: Named archive markers/distance labels are visible in the actual normal-control screenshot.
Functional HUD text is larger and readable at1440x900.
Gold interceptor is visually distinct in the actual targeted extraction screenshot.
Hold-E recovery accumulates progress, cancels on release, completes, and awards the intended partial Standard recovery.
Memory fragment appears as readable content tied to a named person.
Extraction has progress, two spawned local enemies, and progress decay outside zone.
Directional damage arrow appeared in actual screenshots.

remainingPriorities.finding: Enemies outside the forward view can charge and fire without an on-screen pre-attack cue. Damage arrow helps only after being hit. Current enemy markers explicitly skip behind-camera targets.
remainingPriorities.recommendation: Show restrained offscreen charging direction pips/arcs and/or distinct spatial charge warnings; cap or stagger concurrent charged attacks so the player can respond rather than absorb overlapping unseen fire.

remainingPriorities.area: Pressure while moving and exposed burst
remainingPriorities.finding: Continuous simple square movement still preserved fullhealth for35seconds without any shooting/dash. Stopping after that led to death~5.9seconds later despite5kills. This is somewhat improved from baseline but remains binary.
remainingPriorities.recommendation: Test moving/standing/dashing with role-specific pressure and coordinated attack cadence rather than blanket damage increases. Preserve cover and recovery opportunities.

remainingPriorities.finding: Four-second extraction is now readable and has interceptors, but targeted sequence took little health pressure. It can end as the new enemies arrive.
remainingPriorities.recommendation: Consider6–8seconds onOperator/Veteran, or an explicit second short uplinkstage with a new tactical angle; keepRecon shorter. Test an actual full mission before tuning.

remainingPriorities.finding: Every kill still yields24rounds and cores60; resource pressure remains mostlyreloadtiming. One weapon/arena limits replayappeal.
remainingPriorities.recommendation: Tune Standard supplyamount/frequency while preserving a recovery path; add a simple optional challenge/variant encounter only after corecombat feels fair.

remainingPriorities.finding: Controlled extraction could display100% while awaiting the next frame at a floating-point value just below1.
remainingPriorities.recommendation: Use an epsilon completion threshold or floor displayedpercentage below100 until completed.

limitations: Agent review through an automated Chrome browser, not independent human audiencefeedback.
Normal-control section used active enemies and no resource/position/enemy cheats; aiming used exact visible target positions.
Recovery and extraction tests deliberately cleared enemies/arranged positions/stepped simulation to isolate mechanics; they are not full normal-control mission completion.
Headless software rendering and screenshots do not establish targethardware performance or audioquality.
Ratings are provisional judgments and were not inflated toward the requested10.
